reviewer: integration agent, separate from game implementers
method: Read rendered rules and board states. Chose moves in conversation; issued actual Playwright taps. No hidden game-state reading, model solver or forced state in this sample. The reviewer was not a blinded novice.

cases.negativeCase: Deliberately assigned D to route2 and B to route3 in first study; checker correctly explained blocking pair D/3. Swapping them passed.
cases.observation: Preference conflicts grow across 4,5,6 partners. Full displayed rankings support reasoning and feedback names the actual violated constraint.

cases.finding: Repeated identical statements with same operands trivialized generated deduction. Sent implementer to exclude same-operand and duplicate clauses.
Labeled coordinate subtraction lacked promised stereo correspondence. Requested redesign before acceptance.
Numeric table lacked visual synthesis feedback. Requested plotted reference and current wave.
Detached 24-button ray list made phone use long and spatial mapping indirect. Requested perimeter controls.

limits: This is a small ordinary-input review sample, not all100 games.
Review-time snapshots may precede later fixes; full source-matched suites are separate.
No physical phone, screen reader or novice difficulty study.
